## pi-web-ui 0.6.0 beta.0

This desktop beta adds the built-in SSH node workbench. macOS and Windows clients can connect to Linux/macOS SSH nodes, organize them by group, open multiple terminal tabs, browse and edit files over SFTP, and keep a separate Agent conversation for each node. Agent commands run in the selected SSH terminal and remain visible there.

- First connection asks you to verify and trust the host key fingerprint. Changed host keys block reconnection until checked.
- Node credentials stay on each client in encrypted local storage. JSON import/export excludes credentials; legacy Remote-SSH host metadata can be imported.
- The remote account or container defines the Agent's effective permissions. Agent commands on connected nodes run without per-command confirmation.

See the [SSH workbench guide](https://github.com/youweichen0208/pi-web-ui/blob/develop/docs/ssh-workbench.md) and [Xshell guide](https://github.com/youweichen0208/pi-web-ui/blob/develop/docs/xshell.md). The matching npm beta is `@youweichen/pi-web-ui@0.6.0-beta.0`.

These desktop builds are unsigned. On macOS, use right-click → Open for the first launch. On Windows, SmartScreen may show an unknown publisher prompt. Please report beta issues in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/youweichen0208/pi-web-ui/issues).
